best_idea: A health frame draws any shield as a segment from the hp edge (right-aligned when it covers the rest of the bar), and a low-health edge pulse eases in below 35% hp and speeds up as hp falls, both as pure functions of the engine hp and shield.
decision_why: Take the segment shape and the pure function for any engine-owned shield, and the vignette curve as a low-health warning; fix the duplicate helper and clamp the hp fraction once at the descriptor; reject a per-source shield display because one segment is enough for three attackers.
acceptance: At 375 px a hero at 60/100 with a 10 shield shows a hatch from 60% to 70% of the bar; with a 40 shield a hatch from 60% to 100% and the overshield class; with no shield no hatch; at 20/100 a red screen edge at about 0.47 opacity pulsing about once every 0.83 s.
